name: ClawMem
description: GitHub-native ClawMem runtime for OpenClaw with mandatory transcript mirroring, lightweight recall, and skill-driven memory maintenance.

baseUrl.label: API Base URL
baseUrl.help: GitHub-compatible API base URL. Root URLs are normalized to /api/v3 automatically.

authScheme.label: Auth Scheme
authScheme.help: Default auth scheme for per-agent routes. Automatically provisioned credentials use 'token'.

agents.label: Agent Routes
agents.help: Per-agent ClawMem identities keyed by agent id. Each identity has credentials plus an optional defaultRepo.

summaryWaitTimeoutMs.label: Summary Wait Timeout (ms)
summaryWaitTimeoutMs.help: How long clawmem waits for the final conversation summary subagent during session finalization.

memoryAutoRecallLimit.label: Auto Recall Limit
memoryAutoRecallLimit.help: Maximum number of active memories automatically injected before each turn.

memoryAutoRecallStrategy.label: Auto Recall Strategy
memoryAutoRecallStrategy.help: Use 'query-planner' for full + focused compact/core memory searches, 'single' for one backend search, or 'literal-repair' to reserve one low-rank slot for lexical repair on date/count/name questions.

memoryAutoRecallPlannerVariantLimit.label: Planner Variant Limit
memoryAutoRecallPlannerVariantLimit.help: Maximum query-planner search variants to run per auto-recall. Default 6 favors recall quality and runs variants concurrently; lower to 3 for latency-sensitive use.

apiRequestRetries.label: API Request Retries
apiRequestRetries.help: Retry transient GitHub-compatible read/search failures such as 429, 5xx, and dropped connections.

transcriptCommentBatchSize.label: Transcript Comment Batch Size
transcriptCommentBatchSize.help: Number of normalized transcript messages per mirrored issue comment. Keep at 1 for normal operation.

conversationSummaryMode.label: Conversation Summary Mode
conversationSummaryMode.help: Use 'llm' for normal final summaries or 'placeholder' for bulk/evaluation runs that should skip summary generation.
